deliverables: Custodial wallet onboarding in Sellout flow
Independent third-party smart-contract audit with published remediation
Public launch campaign and trade-show activations
Public metrics dashboard and quarterly reporting
Revenue-share repayment mechanism to reimburse the Treasury
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Phase 2 of a Cardano-native ticketing platform operated by Sellout.io and built by Anvil Development Agency, including secondary marketplace, royalty enforcement, anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding, organizer tools, security audit, and launch campaign.

claims.claim: Phase 1 of the Sellout ticketing system is already live on Cardano mainnet with on-chain event creation, CIP-68 ticket minting, transfers, and attendance verification.
Sellout has invested over $130,000 of its own capital into Phase 1.
The proposal requests 4,969,231 ada, equivalent to about $1,093,231 at $0.22 per ADA, including a 3% Intersect administration fee.
Phase 2 is planned to deliver a secondary marketplace, royalty enforcement, anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding, organizer tools, an independent audit, and a launch campaign.
The team commits to repay $1,093,231 to the Cardano Treasury through a revenue-share mechanism, with 25% of fees paid until reimbursement and 5% thereafter.
The exact revenue-base definition and payment cadence for the repayment mechanism will be finalized during M1 contracting with the oversight committee.
Sellout has 200,000+ registered users, has issued 250,000+ tickets to date, and currently supports 350+ events annually.
The Yellowstone Club 2026 deployment is projected to move more than $6 million through Cardano in year one, based on $5.88 million in 2025 historical volume.
The proposal targets 200+ events on-chain, 75,000+ NFT tickets, 150,000+ on-chain interactions, $6 million+ ticket revenue on-chain, and 20,000+ new wallets within 12 months from launch.
All on-chain metrics are claimed to be independently verifiable through Cardano explorer data, policy-ID tracking, a public metrics dashboard, and quarterly Cardano Forum reports.

summary: The document asks for 4,969,231 ada over 8 months to fund Phase 2 of an enterprise ticketing platform, with milestone-gated delivery, Intersect/Sundae TRSC-PSSC administration, audit and reporting commitments, and a proposed revenue-share repayment structure.
